The complete upstream source is retained in upstream/antipodal_sampler.py.
The executable antipodal_sampler.py differs only in replacing the two
embodichain.utils imports with the local _compat imports.
_compat.py maps the configuration decorator to dataclasses.dataclass and the
only used logging method to Python logging. Contact sampling, ray casting,
normal checks, units and return values remain upstream code.

No upstream NOTICE file was present in the pinned repository tree.
This NOTICE records attribution and local modifications; it is not an upstream
notice or a claim that the complete EmbodiChain framework was integrated.
No weights or model training are required by this component.
